scope: All310 references and313 distinct M328-bearing lines from the completed primary concordance recovery
timing: Exploratory: candidate object-type cross-tabulation was inspected before this protocol; no confirmatory p-value or preregistration claim
question: Does the position and short-field use of M328 vary by the primary catalogue's object classification?
required_primary_check: Read object-type column5 in the Texts for each reference. Retain exact metadata text, page and image hash. Do not infer type from a reference range or assume the candidate export is correct.
comparison: Report candidate and primary-reviewed classifications separately; preserve discrepancies and unverified records.
line_identity: Retain reference/side/line and repeated-U token positions from the reviewed corpus. Object type is reference-level; actual direction is line-level and must not be propagated from first-line metadata.
analysis: Descriptive occurrence and reference counts by type and U position, plus undoubted exact long-stroke-plus-U fields. Keep source doubt/loss and reviewer uncertainty; supply loss-free and fully identified sensitivities.
independence: Catalogue references are not proven independent physical objects or molds. No significance test treats occurrences as independent trials.
inference_limit: Object association can constrain inscription format, but neither a numerical value nor a phonetic/semantic reading follows from classification alone. The catalogue class sealings does not by itself establish a sealing was attached to traded goods.
downloads: None planned; use existing primary PDF. Any future download must remain in data/raw with registry provenance.
